name: CSB Bank Limited
summary: CSB Bank Limited provides banking and financial services for small and mid-sized enterprises, large corporates and conglomerates, and domestic and non-resident individuals in India. It operates through Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments.
